question:
Study the table showing the research papers published by five institutions over four years and answer the question.

Institution | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022
IIT-A | 150 | 180 | 210 | 250
IIT-B | 200 | 220 | 240 | 300
IISc | 120 | 130 | 150 | 180
IISER | 90 | 110 | 130 | 160
NIT-X | 100 | 120 | 140 | 170

Q. Which institution registered the highest percentage growth in research papers from 2019 to 2022?
explanation_hi: 2019 से 2022 तक प्रतिशत वृद्धि: IIT-A = 66.67%; IIT-B = 50%; IISc = 50%; IISER = (70/90)*100 = 77.78%; NIT-X = 70%。 IISER में 77.78% की सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत वृद्धि दर्ज की गई।

question:
Study the table below showing cinema tickets sold by a multiplex over seven days, and answer the question.

Day | Regular Tickets | Premium Tickets | Recliner Tickets
Monday | 1,200 | 450 | 150
Tuesday | 900 | 300 | 100
Wednesday | 1,100 | 400 | 120
Thursday | 1,000 | 350 | 130
Friday | 1,800 | 700 | 250
Saturday | 2,600 | 1,100 | 400
Sunday | 2,700 | 1,200 | 450

Q. Which day recorded the lowest combined total of all three categories of tickets?
explanation: Total for Monday = 1200+450+150 = 1800. Total for Tuesday = 900+300+100 = 1300. Total for Wednesday = 1100+400+120 = 1620. Total for Thursday = 1000+350+130 = 1480. Tuesday has the lowest total of 1,300 tickets.

question:
Study the table below that shows the number of internet users (in millions) across three age groups from 2021 to 2023, and answer the question.

Year | Age 15-24 | Age 25-44 | Age 45+
2021 | 120 | 180 | 90
2022 | 150 | 210 | 120
2023 | 180 | 260 | 150

Q. For which age group was the percentage increase in the number of internet users from 2021 to 2023 the highest?
explanation: Percentage increase for Age 15-24 is ((180 - 120)/120)*100 = 50%. For Age 25-44 it is ((260 - 180)/180)*100 = 44.44%. For Age 45+ it is ((150 - 90)/90)*100 = 66.67%. Thus, Age 45+ has the highest percentage increase. Option A is a distractor with a lower percentage.

question:
Study the table below that shows scholarships awarded by category across four years (2020 to 2023), and answer the question.

Year | Merit | Sports | Minority | SC/ST
2020 | 500 | 200 | 300 | 600
2021 | 550 | 250 | 350 | 650
2022 | 600 | 300 | 400 | 700
2023 | 700 | 350 | 450 | 800

Q. For the year 2022, what is the ratio of Sports scholarships to SC/ST scholarships?
explanation: In 2022, Sports scholarships = 300 and SC/ST scholarships = 700. The ratio is 300 : 700, which simplifies to 3 : 7. Options A, C, and D are incorrect ratios.
question_hi:
नीचे दी गई तालिका का अध्ययन कीजिए जो चार वर्षों (2020 से 2023) में श्रेणीवार प्रदान की गई छात्रवृत्तियों को दर्शाती है, और प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए।

वर्ष | मेरिट | खेल (Sports) | अल्पसंख्यक | SC/ST
2020 | 500 | 200 | 300 | 600
2021 | 550 | 250 | 350 | 650
2022 | 600 | 300 | 400 | 700
2023 | 700 | 350 | 450 | 800

प्र. वर्ष 2022 के लिए, खेल छात्रवृत्तियों का SC/ST छात्रवृत्तियों से अनुपात क्या है?
explanation_hi: वर्ष 2022 में, खेल छात्रवृत्तियाँ = 300 और SC/ST छात्रवृत्तियाँ = 700 हैं। अनुपात 300 : 700 है, जो सरल होकर 3 : 7 बनता है। विकल्प A, C और D गलत अनुपात हैं।
